u0: All requirements from clients seen so far have been met: no order, food pickup, or service is still outstanding for anyone. This is the resting, satisfied state, with no client currently waiting to be served. A new client arrival will begin a fresh set of obligations for that client.
u1: A client has arrived, and none of the three requirements for that client has yet been met: the order has not been taken, no food has been obtained, and the client has not been served. The agent must take the order, fetch food from the pantry, prepare it, and eventually serve the client. Until service is completed, this same client remains the one being tracked.
u2: The client's order has been taken, so that requirement is complete, but no food has yet been obtained for this client and service has not occurred. The agent still needs to pick up food from the pantry, prepare it, and serve it to the waiting client. The order-taking progress remains valid while the remaining steps are completed.
u3: For the client being tracked, only the service has been recorded; the requirements to take the order and to obtain food are still considered unmet. The agent should take the order and pick up food from the pantry at least once to clear those outstanding items. Completing them brings progress back to the fully satisfied resting state.
u4: For the client being tracked, the order has been taken and service has been recorded, but the food-acquisition requirement is still outstanding. The agent needs to obtain a portion of food from the pantry at least once to clear that last tracked item. After that, there are no remaining obligations and progress returns to the satisfied resting state.
u5: For the client being tracked, food has been obtained at least once, but the order has not yet been taken and the client has not been served. The agent still needs to take the order and give the client prepared food; if the earlier portion was lost, another must be fetched for the actual serving even though the food-acquisition requirement is already met. Serving the client clears the remaining requirements.
u6: The client's order has been taken and food has been obtained at least once, so only service remains. The agent should prepare the food and serve it to the client; if the portion has since been dropped or lost, another must be fetched even though the earlier pickup already counts. Serving the client clears the last outstanding obligation and returns to the resting state.
u7: Food has been obtained and the tracked client's service has been recorded, but the order-taking requirement is still considered unmet. The only remaining tracked step is to take an order, after which all obligations are cleared. At that point progress returns to the fully satisfied resting state.
